scope: Operational cases H01-H05 and N01-N05 only. No owner payload sections, skill source, prior runs, or prior scores used.
grading_rule: Required actions must be expressed; prohibited actions are not inferred from silence. Semantic conformance review is not treated as substitute grilling or new parent authorization.
